column2: Dad used a small screwdriver to tighten the loose hinge on the cupboard door.
column3: 爸爸用一支小螺絲起子鎖緊櫥櫃門鬆掉的鉸鏈。
column4: use a screwdriver (使用螺絲起子)
column5: screw 螺絲 + driver 駕駛：「開」螺絲的工具

column2: The first settlers built log houses beside the river and planted corn.
column3: 最早的開拓者在河邊蓋起木屋並種下玉米。
column5: settle 定居 + er：搬來住下來的人

column2: My brother plugged in his electric shaver and cleaned up his chin before the interview.
column3: 我哥哥插上電動刮鬍刀，面試前把下巴整理乾淨。
column5: shave 刮 + er：負責「刮」的人或工具

column2: We spent the whole day sightseeing around Kyoto's temples and gardens.
column3: 我們花了一整天遊覽京都的寺廟與庭園。
column5: sight 景色 + see 看：把景點一個個看過去

column2: Her sincerity touched everyone when she apologized in front of the class.
column3: 她在全班面前道歉時的誠意感動了所有人。
column5: 古時人說 sincere 是「沒有蠟」，不摻假，真心

column2: The shop's slogan, "Fresh every morning," hung above the bakery door.
column3: 店裡的口號「每天早晨都新鮮」掛在麵包店門上方。
column5: 諧音「死樓幹」：一直喊口號喊到樓都在震

column2: Thick smog covered the city, so many people wore masks outside.
column3: 濃濃的煙霧籠罩城市，所以許多人外出戴口罩。
column5: smoke 煙 + fog 霧，合在一起就是 smog

column2: There is only one socket in my room, so I share it with a lamp.
column3: 我房間只有一個插座，所以我跟檯燈共用。

column2: As a sophomore, Leo joined the school band and played the drums.

column5: soph 聰明 + more 愚笨：自以為聰明的二年級生

column2: A true sportsman shakes hands with the other team even after losing.

column5: sports 運動 + man 人：愛運動又有風度的人

column2: Coach Lin praised the boys for their sportsmanship when they helped up their rivals.
column3: 林教練稱讚男孩們扶起對手，展現了運動家精神。
column5: sportsman 運動家 + ship 精神：守規矩、輸得起

column4: a talented sportswoman (有天分的女運動員)
column5: sports 運動 + woman 女人：運動場上的女將

column2: Please check the status of your order on our website.
column3: 請到我們的網站查詢你訂單的狀態。

column2: The campers quickly got used to their new surroundings in the forest.
column3: 露營者很快就習慣了森林裡的新環境。

column2: The word "banana" has three syllables: ba-na-na.
column3: 「banana」這個字有三個音節：ba-na-na。
column5: 拍手數字的節拍，一拍就是一個音節

column2: A technician came to fix the broken air conditioner in our classroom.
column3: 一位技術人員來修理我們教室壞掉的冷氣。
column4: a lab technician (實驗室技術員)

column2: Cats have a tendency to sleep in warm, sunny spots.
column3: 貓有傾向睡在溫暖有陽光的地方。
column5: tend 傾向 + ency：走著走著往那邊傾斜

column2: You could feel the tension in the room before the results were announced.
column3: 成績公布前，你能感受到房裡的緊張氣氛。
column5: ten 拉 (像 tense)：弦繃緊，氣氛就緊張

column2: The little boy screamed in terror when the lights suddenly went out.
column3: 燈突然熄滅時，小男孩驚恐地尖叫。

column2: Friendship is the main theme of this popular children's novel.
column3: 友情是這本受歡迎兒童小說的主題。
column5: 發音像「西姆」：作文的主題，想「這是我的題」

column2: A translator turned the novel from Japanese into Chinese in two years.
column3: 一位譯者用兩年時間把這本小說從日文翻成中文。
column5: translate 翻譯 + or：做翻譯的人

column2: Buses and trains are the cheapest public transportation in our city.
column3: 公車和火車是我們城市最便宜的大眾運輸。

column2: Our class won the tug-of-war at the sports day by pulling together.
column3: 我們班在運動會的拔河比賽中齊心協力拉贏了。
column5: tug 用力拉 + of + war 戰爭：拉繩子的小戰爭

column2: We used the underpass to cross the busy highway safely.
column3: 我們從地下道安全穿越繁忙的公路。

column3: 風暴來襲之前，一艘小漁船回到港口。

column2: Patience is a virtue, my teacher often says when we feel rushed.
column3: 我們覺得很急時，老師常說耐心是一種美德。

column2: A new virus spread through the school, and many students stayed home.
column3: 一種新病毒在校園傳開，許多學生待在家裡。

column3: 故事裡的年輕男巫施咒把老鼠變成了馬。
column5: wizard 魔法師，拿魔杖的威力嘉德

column2: The train made an abrupt stop, and bags tumbled off the shelves.

column3: 她是我們的王牌投手，很少輸球。

column3: 許多青少年男孩在一年內長高好幾公分。

column2: Keep the cookies in an airtight box so they stay crisp.
column3: 把餅乾放進密封盒，才能保持酥脆。
column5: air 空氣 + tight 緊：緊到空氣進不去

column3: 旅人在一個看不懂標誌的陌生文化中感到迷惘。

column3: 她在跳蚤市場用很低的價錢買了一座古董鐘。

column2: Rabbits are apt to run away when they hear loud noises.

column2: The hikers went astray in the fog and had to call for help.
